AUTH_RATE_LIMITED: Kuedza kupinda kwakundikana kakawanda. Ndapota edzai zvakare gare gare.
AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Zita remushandisi kana pasiwedhi hazvisi izvo.
AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID: Kupinda kwenyu kwapera kana kuti hakuna kunaka. Ndapota pindai zvakare.
USER_TOKEN_INVALID: Tokeni yechikumbiro chenyu haina kunaka. Vhurai peji zvakare mozoedza zvakare.
SITE_TOKEN_INVALID: Tokeni yesaiti haina kunaka. Vhurai peji zvakare mozoedza zvakare.
INSTALL_TOKEN_INVALID: Tokeni yekuisa haina kunaka kana kuti haipo.
USER_NOT_SET_UP: Mushandisi uyu haasati agadzirira HAXIAM. Anofanira kutanga apinda.
USER_ALREADY_HAS_ACCESS: Mushandisi uyu atove nemvumo pasaiti iyi.
FEATURE_DISABLED_OUTLINE: Kushandura marongerwo emapeji kwakadzimwa pasaiti iyi.
FEATURE_DISABLED_PAGE_DETAILS: Kugadzirisa ruzivo rwepeji kwakadzimwa pasaiti iyi.
FILE_RATE_LIMITED: Mabasa emafaira akawandisa pasaiti iyi. Edzai zvakare mushure me {retryAfter}.
SITE_NAME_INVALID: Mazita esaiti anogona kushandisa mavara, nhamba, mahaifeni nemaandasikoro chete.
USER_NAME_INVALID: Mazita evashandisi anogona kushandisa mavara, nhamba, mahaifeni nemaandasikoro chete.
SITE_THEME_INVALID: Dingindira iri harigoni kushandiswa pasaiti itsva.
ITEM_COUNT_MISMATCH: Huwandu hwemapeji hwachinja zvisingatarisirwi, saka hapana chakachengetwa.
PAGE_BREAK_REQUIRED: Zviri mukati zvinofanira kuva nekuparadzanisa peji. Zviri mushure mazvo chete ndizvo zvinochengetwa.
ALT_FORMATS_FAILED: Hazvigoneke kugadziridza mamwe mafomati esaiti iyi.
UPLOAD_NOT_VALID: Faira rakaiswa harisi faira re {expected} rakanaka.
UPLOAD_XLS_UNSUPPORTED: Mafaira ekare e .xls haatsigirwe. Chengetai faira se .xlsx mozoedza zvakare.
UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: Faira rakakura kupfuura muganhu we {maxMb} MB wekuisa.
DECK_NAME_FAILED: Hazvigoneke kuwana zita repakeji yemaslide kubva pazita refaira.
IMAGE_RASTER_ONLY: Mifananidzo yeraster chete (yakaita seJPG kana PNG) ndiyo inogona kugadziriswa nenzira iyi.
IMAGE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: Fomati iyi yemufananidzo haigoni kugadziriswa ipapo.
SEARCH_TEXT_TOO_SHORT: Mavara ekutsvaga anofanira kupfuura vara rimwe kuti atsiviwe.
REPLACE_TEXT_TOO_SHORT: Mavara ekutsiva anofanira kuva asina chinhu kana kupfuura vara rimwe.
REMOVE_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Kubvisa mavara awanikwa kunoda kusimbiswa kwechipiri.
SEARCH_NO_MATCHES: Izwi ramatsvaga harina kuwanikwa muzviri musaiti.
STYLE_GUIDE_EXTERNAL: Gwaro remaitiro rinobva kunze uye harigoni kugadziriswa muHAXcms.
IMPORT_SOURCE_INVALID: Kwabva zvekupinza hakuna kuwanikwa kana kuverengwa.
